about.title: About us NJUKA
about.content: NJUKA was born from a daily reality every Cameroonian knows: electricity and water outages that come without warning. The app turns the community's experience into useful information — everyone reports the outages around them, neighbours confirm, and everybody gets alerted when the service is back and about official planned outages. An initiative by Bogal Consulting, designed in Cameroon, for Cameroon.

why.title: Why NJUKA?
why.problem_text: In Cameroon, electricity and water can go out without warning — sometimes for hours, sometimes for days. Everyone endures it, without knowing whether the outage affects their street, their neighbourhood or the whole city.
why.community_title: Information from the people living it
why.community_text: NJUKA relies on the community: every reported outage is confirmed by neighbours. The more confirmations, the more reliable the information — and everyone knows right away whether the problem is local or general.
why.data_text: Reported outages, durations, service restorations, official planned outages from Eneo: NJUKA turns the experience of thousands of users into useful information to plan your day, your business or your travel.

cta.title: Together, we see clearly.

aboutus.desc_page: NJUKA is the Cameroonian mobile app for reporting electricity and water outages: a community that stays informed, confirms and helps each other, built by Bogal Consulting.
aboutus.text_history_1: In Cameroon, an electricity or water outage is part of daily life: it comes without warning, sometimes lasts hours or days, and everyone endures it without knowing whether it affects their street, their neighbourhood or the whole city. The project was born in 2020 from a simple observation: this information exists — the residents themselves hold it. First launched as LightCutOff, focused on electricity, the project grew and became NJUKA: a mobile app covering electricity and water, developed and published by Bogal Consulting.
aboutus.text_obj_1: Give everyone reliable, real-time information about the outages around them. With NJUKA, you report an electricity (Eneo) or water (Camwater) outage in seconds, your neighbours confirm it — or deny it —, you get alerted when an outage is reported near you and when the service is back, and you check the official planned outages every day. The bigger the community, the more accurate the information: that is the meaning of our motto, “Together, we see clearly.”
aboutus.text_obj_2: Every report, every confirmation and every service restoration feeds a unique collective knowledge of the real availability of electricity and water. Our long-term ambition: turn this data into forecasts — knowing when the power is likely to go out, and when it should come back — to move from enduring the information to anticipating it. Designed for Cameroon, NJUKA is built from day one to expand to other African countries.

tuto.desc_page: Learn how to use NJUKA: install the app, report an electricity or water outage, confirm ongoing outages and get alerts.
tuto.alert_country: For now, NJUKA is only available in Cameroon: reports made outside Cameroon are not accepted.
tuto.step_install_text: Download NJUKA on Google Play (Android) or on the App Store (iPhone). No account needed to get started: you can report and browse anonymously.
tuto.step_report_text: Electricity ⚡ or water 💧 outage at your place? Tap the “Report” button, pick the affected service: your report is geolocated and visible to your neighbours within seconds.
tuto.step_confirm_text: When an outage is reported near you, the app asks “At your place too?”. Confirm if you are affected, or deny if everything works at home: the more confirmations, the more reliable the information. When the service is back, declare it — the reporter and confirmers are notified.
tuto.step_alert_text: Check the official planned outages announced by Eneo every day, follow your neighbourhoods and get alerted the day before an outage is scheduled there.
tuto.web_map_text: The website lets you browse the reported outage map in read-only mode. To report, confirm or get alerted, use the app.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: NJUKA is currently available in Cameroon only, for electricity (Eneo) and water (Camwater) outages. The app is designed to expand to other African countries.
faq.a2: Yes, the app is completely free, with no in-app purchases.
faq.q3: How do I install NJUKA on my phone?
faq.a3: On Android, download the app from Google Play. On iPhone, from the App Store.
faq.q4: Do I need an account to use the app?
faq.a4: No. You can report, confirm and browse outages without creating an account. Creating one (e-mail, Google, Facebook or Apple) is optional: it keeps your history and username if you switch phones.
faq.q5: How do I report an electricity or water outage?
faq.a5: From the app: tap “Report”, pick the affected service (electricity or water), and you're done — your report is geolocated and visible to neighbours within seconds. The website lets you browse the outage map in read-only mode.
faq.q6: How do I know a reported outage is reliable?
faq.a6: Every outage can be confirmed — or denied — by neighbours. The confirmation count is shown on each report: the more confirmations, the more reliable the information. When the service is back, the report becomes “resolved” and the reporter and confirmers are notified.
faq.q7: How do I get alerted about outages?
faq.a7: Enable the app's notifications: you'll be alerted when an outage is reported near you, when the service is back, and the day before an official planned outage (Eneo schedule) in the neighbourhoods you follow.
faq.q8: What do you do with my location and data?
faq.a8: Your location is only used to geolocate your reports and alert you about nearby outages. Your data is never sold or shared for advertising. Details in our privacy policy; you can also delete your account at any time.
